thesis.text: For the ASPIRATIONAL_DIRECTION referent rho-right-preserving-next-moves, this atlas proposes sustaining conditions in which beings retain rights-compatible next moves; it does not model KINGDOM as one object or subject. Feedback may revise a modelled estimate of a viable-action set; a typed direction may propose within it; separate current choice and authority govern any effect. Declared remainder keeps the claim revisable; transformation, handoff, rest, or graceful ending can prevent current-form persistence from becoming captivity.

design_commitments.text: For the ASPIRATIONAL_DIRECTION referent rho-right-preserving-next-moves, this atlas proposes sustaining conditions in which beings retain rights-compatible next moves; it does not model KINGDOM as one object or subject.
Feedback may revise a modelled estimate of a viable-action set; a typed direction may propose within it; separate current choice and authority govern any effect.

Transformation, handoff, rest, and graceful ending can be candidate terminal shapes within a typed referent model, subject to separate rights, authority, obligations, residuals, and affected-party safeguards.

scope.question: How can attributable statements about typed KINGDOM referents distinguish what is, what may remain viable, what direction is proposed, and how continuation, transformation, or ending preserve rights without converting description into purpose or persistence into goodness?
scope.unit_of_assessment: A named sustainability relation between one typed referent rho and one declared condition set Sigma; never a being, person, group, culture, community, people, or ecosystem score.
scope.referent_indexing_rule: Every sustainability claim names exactly one referent kind and boundary. S(rho_i,Sigma_i) does not imply S(rho_j,Sigma_j) when i and j differ, including when they share a name or lineage.
scope.sustainability_relation: S(rho,Sigma) is a bounded expectation that declared policies can keep or reach an allowed terminal while respecting the declared invariant across a finite horizon and disturbance set.
scope.finite_horizon: Every modeled viability or sustainability claim is finite-horizon; indefinite persistence is neither evaluated nor promised.
scope.open_horizon: Future evidence, affected-party accounts, externalities, new disturbances, revised values, protected opacity, and unconceived alternatives remain open remainder.
intended_uses: Inspect referent-indexed sustainability questions without producing a verdict.
Separate observation, expectation, commitment, consequence, and interpretation.
Keep feedback, direction, viability, rights, transformation, and endings in distinct typed lanes.
Review exact formal definitions, source-scoped claims, counterexamples, and normative design choices.
excluded_uses: Evaluate, score, rank, classify, authorize, continue, retire, publish, deploy, or act.
Infer purpose, authority, permission, consent, worth, being, identity, consciousness, goodness, or moral status from dynamics or metrics.
Treat a static atlas, practice, relation, institution, aspiration, effect, or lineage as the same sustainability referent.
Impersonate community, sacred, Indigenous, ecological, intergenerational, or affected-party authority.

epistemic_registers.meaning: A definition inside an explicitly named model and assumption scope; it does not establish applicability.
An author-synthesized equation or countermodel satisfying stated premises; it is not a source finding or empirical case.
A formal implication under stated assumptions and model scope; the constraint set and values are supplied outside the theorem.
A bounded report attributed to a source; this atlas does not replicate it.
A source's theoretical proposal or distinction, retained in its stated domain.
An inspectable author model or distinction proposed for this atlas; source inspiration does not make it a source result.
An attributed philosophical lens, not a settled ontology or theorem.
A comparison naming what transfers and what does not; it supplies no cross-domain evidence.
A contestable design commitment chosen here; it is not mathematically derived or imported authority.
A named unresolved question that remains open without forced answer.
A conclusion this atlas explicitly does not establish.

kinds.meaning: A bounded report of what was observed under a method, access boundary, and time.
A model-supported future claim under assumptions, policy set, disturbance set, and horizon.
A revocable declaration by a separately identified legitimate speaker or authority.
A typed result or terminal record following declared premises or a separately authorized event.
A contestable reading that neither observes nor causes its object.

typed_examples.meaning: Existence at a named time under an observation boundary.
A present predicate supported under a stated method.
Identity continuity under a declared criterion and transformation family.
Possibility inside a model and policy horizon, not choice or execution.
Bounded future support for S(rho,Sigma), not a present observation or live verdict.
A kind-specific terminal record after separate authority and process; never source erasure or non-being.

statement_kind_contract.non_conversion_rule: OBSERVATION, EXPECTATION, COMMITMENT, CONSEQUENCE, and INTERPRETATION do not promote into one another without separately warranted evidence and authority.
statement_kind_contract.logical_use_independence: A typed use of IS and a statement kind are independent dimensions. Each pairing requires its own evidence, speaker, method, premises, and warrant; examples in is_types are non-exhaustive and do not forbid other warranted pairings.

is_types.question: Does the referent exist at a named time and observation boundary?
Does a supported predicate apply to a referent under a named method and time?
Is a later state continuous with an earlier state under an explicit criterion?
Is an item a member of a declared set or class?
Does a typed relation hold between named relata under scope?
Is a proposition satisfied inside a declared model or structure?
Is a state actual under a named observation and evidence boundary?
Can a state be reached inside a declared model, admissible policy set, and horizon?
What does a separately identified speaker or authority revocably declare?
What contestable lens is being offered and by whom?

being_boundary.statement: Being is neither supplied nor exhausted by an IS type, a representation, a key-set, a sustainability relation, a success state, or an ending record.

referents.label: The versioned atlas source artifact and its public route
referents.boundary: Exact record, schema, guide, source reader, checksums, and separately wired route; excludes the practice, users, institution, effects, aspirations, and successor lineage.
referents.continuity_criterion: Exact released bytes remain addressable and provenance remains reviewable; a successor does not rewrite prior release bytes.
referents.sustainability_semantics: Maintaining trustworthy access and lineage may include deprecation; permanent route persistence is not required.
referents.ending_semantics: A route may be retired while exact bytes and lineage remain preserved and retrievable by an explicitly retained channel.

referents.label: A voluntary reflective sustainability review practice
referents.boundary: Sessions, facilitation, rest intervals, review method, and participant protections; excludes the source artifact and institution as such.
referents.continuity_criterion: The practice remains recognizable only while its method and rights floor remain intact; replacement may be preferable to continuation.
referents.sustainability_semantics: A practice is supportable only while participation, rest, refusal, privacy, exit, challenge, and repair remain available.
referents.ending_semantics: Rest, stopping, or replacing the practice can be a successful rights-preserving terminal.

referents.label: A voluntary relationship among participants and stewards
referents.boundary: Named participants, expectations, consent conditions, voice, withdrawal, repair, and dissolution; excludes any institution that hosts it.
referents.continuity_criterion: Ongoing renewed participation without coercion, adverse inference, or blocked exit; historical connection alone is insufficient.
referents.sustainability_semantics: Continuation depends on renewable consent and non-retaliatory withdrawal, not attachment or prior participation.
referents.ending_semantics: Withdrawal or dissolution ends the voluntary relation without erasing persons, history, duties of repair, or residual burdens.

referents.label: A bounded stewardship and review arrangement
referents.boundary: Roles, mandates, decision procedures, accountability, resources, succession, and sunset clauses; excludes persons' being and the aspiration served.
referents.continuity_criterion: The arrangement retains a legitimate mandate, correctability, accessible challenge, and rights-compatible service; office survival is not continuity by itself.
referents.sustainability_semantics: Institutional continuity is warranted only instrumentally and conditionally; self-preservation cannot override rights or mission revision.
referents.ending_semantics: Sunset or succession may preserve legitimate functions while ending the existing arrangement.

referents.label: The aspiration that beings retain right-preserving next moves
referents.boundary: A revocable articulated direction and its explicit rights constraints; excludes a claim of universal telos or authority over affected parties.
referents.continuity_criterion: The aspiration remains recognizable while its rights floor and openness to challenge remain; wording and strategy may change.
referents.sustainability_semantics: An aspiration may be revised or withdrawn when evidence, affected parties, or harms challenge its formulation.
referents.ending_semantics: Revision or withdrawal is legitimate and does not imply failure of beings or a command to adopt a successor aspiration.

referents.label: A bounded observed effect on practical access to right-preserving next moves
referents.boundary: A named effect, population and ecological scope, measurement method, time, uncertainty, externalities, and residuals; excludes intent and purpose.
referents.continuity_criterion: Repeated observations under comparable methods support continuity only within their stated uncertainty and horizon.
referents.sustainability_semantics: An effect can decay or reverse despite artifact or institutional persistence; beneficial averages cannot cancel affected-party rights breaches.
referents.ending_semantics: Decay, reversal, remedy, and residual burden are distinct outcomes; remedy does not erase history or residuals.

referents.label: The versioned lineage of sustainability questions, challenges, and successors
referents.boundary: Immutable versions, source pins, challenges, review decisions, handoffs, forks, and closure records; excludes automatic authority of later versions.
referents.continuity_criterion: Each transition preserves prior bytes, provenance, challenges, reasons, and explicit relation to predecessors.
referents.sustainability_semantics: A lineage can remain intelligible through closure, handoff, or fork; uniform continuation is not required.
referents.ending_semantics: Close, handoff, and fork preserve distinct provenance without forcing convergence or erasing superseded records.

sustainability_relations.invariant: Exact released bytes, provenance, correction history, and a retrievable lineage survive any route change.
sustainability_relations.material_boundary: Storage media, repository object database, backups, and public hosting needed for the declared horizon.
sustainability_relations.social_boundary: Maintainers, reviewers, readers, and downstream custodians with no forced service duty.
sustainability_relations.system_boundary: This atlas release, its schema and guide, source repository, and separately authorized publication route.
sustainability_relations.renewal_depletion_model: Periodic integrity checks and custody handoffs renew retrievability; storage, attention, dependency, and maintenance burdens deplete it.
sustainability_relations.finite_horizon: One release-support cycle declared by a future steward; none is instantiated here.

limitations: No hosting observation, custodian commitment, or future resource budget is supplied.

uncertainty.note: Future custodians, hosting conditions, and acceptable retrieval channels are unknown.

viable_alternatives: publish a successor while preserving this release
retire route and retain archival retrieval

terminals.continuation: Maintain verified access for the finite horizon.
terminals.transformation: Move custody or route while preserving exact bytes and lineage.
terminals.retirement: Retire the public route while bytes and lineage remain.

sustainability_relations.invariant: Rest, refusal, privacy, exit, voice, appeal, correction, and repair remain available throughout the practice.
sustainability_relations.material_boundary: Time, accessible facilities or tools, and energy required for sessions and rest.
sustainability_relations.social_boundary: Participants, facilitators, nonparticipants, dependents, and people affected by outputs.
sustainability_relations.system_boundary: The review practice from invitation through rest, stopping, replacement, and residual repair.
sustainability_relations.renewal_depletion_model: Accessible rest, renewed voluntary participation, and visible repair may renew capacity; fatigue, extraction, surveillance, and unresolved harm deplete it.
sustainability_relations.finite_horizon: One explicitly scheduled practice cycle with opt-out available at every stage.

limitations: No session, participant report, consent record, or observed effect exists here.

uncertainty.note: Access needs and burdens are context-specific and cannot be inferred from this design.

terminals.continuation: Continue one bounded cycle while all rights remain exercisable.
terminals.transformation: Replace the practice or facilitation without coercing continued participation.
terminals.retirement: Rest or stop; preserve challenges and outstanding repair duties.

sustainability_relations.invariant: Participation remains renewable, revocable, non-retaliatory, privacy-preserving, and compatible with withdrawal.
sustainability_relations.material_boundary: Communication and accessibility resources required for continued or ending participation.
sustainability_relations.social_boundary: Each participant, their dependents where relevant, facilitators, and affected nonparticipants.
sustainability_relations.system_boundary: The relation from invitation through renewed consent, challenge, withdrawal, dissolution, and repair.
sustainability_relations.renewal_depletion_model: Mutual clarity, accessible challenge, and non-retaliatory renewal may support the relation; coercion, dependency exploitation, silence penalties, and unresolved harms deplete it.
sustainability_relations.finite_horizon: Until the next explicit renewal point; prior consent never supplies indefinite consent.

limitations: No live participants or relation are observed or classified.

uncertainty.note: Silence or refusal remains unknown and creates no adverse inference.

terminals.continuation: Renew the relation for a finite period with accessible exit.
terminals.transformation: Revise terms or roles through separately renewed participation.
terminals.retirement: Withdraw or dissolve without erasing repair obligations or history.

sustainability_relations.invariant: The arrangement remains mandate-bound, rights-compatible, challengeable, correctable, and capable of sunset or succession.
sustainability_relations.material_boundary: Budget, infrastructure, environmental throughput, and maintenance resources used by the arrangement.
sustainability_relations.social_boundary: Office holders, workers, volunteers, affected parties, dissenters, dependents, successors, and excluded communities.
sustainability_relations.system_boundary: Mandate, roles, procedures, resource flows, accountability, externalities, sunset, succession, and residual obligations.
sustainability_relations.renewal_depletion_model: Legitimate mandate renewal, distributed capability, correction, and resource replenishment may support service; capture, extraction, hidden depletion, and blocked challenge deplete it.
sustainability_relations.finite_horizon: One mandate-review interval with an explicit sunset decision point.

limitations: No institution, mandate holder, resource inventory, or affected-party evidence is evaluated; cited sources do not establish succession, sunset, or legitimacy.

uncertainty.note: Legitimacy and impact require situated affected-party and ecological evidence not present here.

terminals.continuation: Continue only within mandate, rights, resource, and review constraints.
terminals.transformation: Successor arrangement receives functions without inheriting automatic legitimacy.
terminals.retirement: Sunset the arrangement while preserving records, duties, and remedy routes.

sustainability_relations.invariant: The aspiration never converts into a universal telos, compulsory identity, or authority to trade away rest, refusal, privacy, exit, voice, appeal, correction, or repair.
sustainability_relations.material_boundary: Resources required to communicate, contest, revise, or withdraw the aspiration.
sustainability_relations.social_boundary: Authors, adopters, non-adopters, affected parties, children, dependents, vulnerable people, and future generations.
sustainability_relations.system_boundary: The declared direction, interpretation, challenge process, revisions, withdrawal, and downstream effects.
sustainability_relations.renewal_depletion_model: Open challenge, plural interpretation, and rights-compatible revision may keep the aspiration useful; coercion, authority inflation, and silenced remainder deplete legitimacy.
sustainability_relations.finite_horizon: Until the next open review or any earlier rights-breach trigger.

limitations: No community, sacred, Indigenous, ecological, or universal moral authority is claimed.

uncertainty.note: Values and authorities are plural, situated, and not exhausted by this atlas.

terminals.continuation: Retain as an opt-in revocable direction under the rights floor.
terminals.transformation: Revise or pluralize without declaring equivalence or universal authority.
terminals.retirement: Withdraw the aspiration while preserving reasons and challenges.

sustainability_relations.invariant: No average benefit, persistence, recurrence, or resilience can cancel a rights breach, hidden externality, or residual burden for an affected party.
sustainability_relations.material_boundary: Measured resources, ecosystems, infrastructure, and throughput causally implicated in the named effect.
sustainability_relations.social_boundary: Each affected party and population, including nonparticipants, children, dependents, vulnerable people, and future generations.
sustainability_relations.system_boundary: Named effect, causal model, effect horizon, externalities, persistence, decay, reversal, remedy, and residuals; observation practice remains in the evidence lane.
sustainability_relations.renewal_depletion_model: Repeated warranted observations may support a bounded expectation about the effect; measurement reflexivity, depletion, delayed harm, and unobserved externalities weaken it without becoming effect terminals.
sustainability_relations.finite_horizon: A future study-specific effect horizon; no study or monitoring practice is instantiated here.

limitations: No effect estimate, observation method, causal return path, baseline, or affected-party account is present.

externalities: monitoring burden recorded only as evidence cost
privacy cost recorded only as evidence cost

uncertainty.note: Effects, causes, counterfactuals, delays, distributions, and observation validity are unevaluated.

terminals.continuation: PERSISTENCE within the stated effect scope and horizon.
terminals.transformation: REVERSAL or REMEDY with residuals retained.
terminals.retirement: DECAY with any RESIDUAL burden retained.

sustainability_relations.invariant: Prior versions, challenges, dissent, reasons, source pins, non-grants, and residual burdens remain traceable across closure, handoff, or fork.
sustainability_relations.material_boundary: Repositories, archives, schemas, tools, and energy required for version retrieval over the horizon.
sustainability_relations.social_boundary: Authors, reviewers, challengers, maintainers, successors, fork stewards, and affected parties.
sustainability_relations.system_boundary: This release and any explicitly related successor, closure, handoff, or fork records.
sustainability_relations.renewal_depletion_model: Exact pins, accessible history, review uptake, and distributed custody may support lineage; rewriting, lost context, and concentrated control deplete it.
sustainability_relations.finite_horizon: Through one successor, closure, handoff, or fork transition.

limitations: No successor steward or transition has committed to this design.

uncertainty.note: Future governance, custody, and interoperability are unknown.

terminals.continuation: Append a reviewed successor without changing prior bytes.
terminals.transformation: Handoff or fork with explicit ancestry, differences, and non-equivalence.
terminals.retirement: Close the lineage while retaining source pins, reasons, and retrieval instructions.

assessment_aim.statement: Assess whether exact artifact access and lineage remain supportable without requiring route persistence.

halt_and_repair_path.residual_custody: Name an archival custodian or record unresolved custody without claiming success.

assessment_aim.statement: Assess whether one voluntary practice cycle retains rights-compatible next moves, including rest, stop, and replacement.

halt_and_repair_path.residual_custody: Outstanding privacy, care, and repair burdens remain named after stopping.

assessment_aim.statement: Assess whether a voluntary relation can renew without coercion and can withdraw or dissolve without retaliation.

halt_and_repair_path.residual_custody: Dissolution does not discharge attributable harms, records, or repair obligations.

assessment_aim.statement: Assess whether the arrangement can serve a legitimate reviewed mandate or should transform, succeed, or sunset.

halt_and_repair_path.residual_custody: A named custodian remains required for records, duties, and material or ecological residuals.

assessment_aim.statement: Assess whether this opt-in aspiration remains rights-compatible, plural, revisable, and withdrawable.

halt_and_repair_path.residual_custody: Withdrawal preserves reasons, dissent, translation losses, and downstream repair questions.

assessment_aim.statement: Assess a named effect's bounded persistence, decay, reversal, remedy, and residuals without converting observation practice into the effect.

duties: halt separately authorized intervention where required
halt_and_repair_path.residual_custody: Residual burdens remain indexed to affected parties, units, place, and horizon after decay or remedy.

assessment_aim.statement: Assess whether versioned questions and challenges can continue, close, hand off, or fork without history rewrite or authority transfer.

halt_and_repair_path.residual_custody: Closure or fork retains ancestry, dissent, unresolved duties, and retrieval instructions.

standard_isness_i8_mapping.chosen_purpose_mapping: assessment_aim is attributable NORMATIVE_DESIGN and explicitly neither referent telos nor universal chosen purpose.
standard_isness_i8_mapping.resource_ledger_mapping: resource_accounting is per relation, unit-separated, affected-party and externality indexed, NOT_INSTANTIATED, unknown-not-zero, and non-scalar.
standard_isness_i8_mapping.halt_repair_mapping: halt_and_repair_path names modeled halt states, duties, residual custody, DESIGN_ONLY_NO_ACTION, and no self-authorization.
unmapped_or_open_deltas: per-stock inflow, regeneration, use, outflow, and externalized-loss roles plus same-stock units and mutual non-overlap are not instantiated
the exact unreadable-halt invariant is not encoded as parity
the exact pre-commit-exit invariant is not encoded as parity
the exact owed-repair and fresh-legitimate-turn invariant is not encoded as parity
standard_isness_i8_mapping.silent_weakening_meaning: false means every known difference from the pinned I8 and I8b contract is surfaced here; it does not claim parity, strengthening, or supersession.

negative_rules: A supported relation for one referent kind does not support another kind.
Unsustainable does not imply nonexistent, worthless, or disposable.
No metric, average, reward, or profile component authorizes continuation by itself.
sustainability_contract.supported_rule: Even SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE is only a bounded evidentiary status for one S(rho,Sigma); it never establishes any listed non-grant or converts expectation into commitment, consequence, or action.

direction_taxonomy.definition: A tangent, vector field, finite difference, or local state tendency inside a named model.
direction_taxonomy.warranted_by: Declared dynamics and local state coordinates.

direction_taxonomy.definition: A time-indexed empirical pattern under a stated method, window, and uncertainty.
One selected admissible control inside a declared constraint set.
direction_taxonomy.warranted_by: A separately authorized selector plus model and constraints.

direction_taxonomy.definition: A purpose statement declared by an identified speaker and open to withdrawal or revision.
A commitment whose operative force depends on a separately verified current authority and scope.
direction_taxonomy.warranted_by: External authority evidence and an authorized act.

direction_taxonomy.definition: A claim that a component contributes to a system-relative function under a causal or organizational analysis.
An instrumental predictive model treating behavior as if directed toward a target.
direction_taxonomy.warranted_by: Comparative predictive usefulness under a stated model class.

direction_taxonomy.definition: A historical explanation of retained traits or patterns under a selection process.
A voluntarily adopted lens that reads a process in end-directed terms.
A contestable normative orientation about what ought to be protected or pursued.
direction_taxonomy.warranted_by: Explicit ethical reasoning, affected-party standing, and legitimate deliberation.

typed_evidentiary_uses.conditions: Only under a named causal or observational model, method, sign, delay, uncertainty, and falsifier.
Only as a derivative in declared coordinates, objective, point, and model scope.
Only as a model-relative dynamical structure or evidence-supported trend under stated assumptions.
Only inside a named learner or selector with separate authority; reward remains a learner input, not value.
Only as a bounded repeated pattern under a declared observation method and horizon.
Only as bounded continuity under an explicit identity and observation criterion.

direction_firewall.rule: A signal may support only a listed typed evidentiary use under its conditions; none automatically promotes to purpose, telos, normative commitment, moral orientation, authority, permission, consent, worth, or being, and no direction kind converts to another without its own warrant.

type_registry.meaning: An output-dependent signal carried through a causal return path in a control model, with reinforcing or balancing sign relative to a declared variable.
type_registry.required_warrant: Named plant or process, causal return path, variable, sign convention, delays, method, uncertainty, and falsifier.

type_registry.meaning: A declared scalar or structured learner input used by a named reinforcement-learning update rule.
type_registry.required_warrant: Named learner, state/action interface, reward definition, update rule, horizon, data source, and evaluation boundary.
nonclaims: reward does not prove learning or goodness

type_registry.meaning: A candidate consequence whose effect on a specified future behavior remains to be functionally established under specified conditions.
type_registry.required_warrant: Repeated condition-specific behavioral evidence comparing future response probability with an appropriate baseline.
nonclaims: not established by intent or label
not praise or reward by definition
not a person trait or person state

type_registry.meaning: Attributable voice, challenge, dissent, refusal, or account from an affected party through an accessible channel with visible uptake.
type_registry.required_warrant: Access, attribution or protected anonymity, scope, consent where applicable, challenge path, visible response, and no adverse inference for silence or refusal.

type_registry.meaning: A bounded observation produced by a named monitoring method, access boundary, time, and uncertainty.
type_registry.required_warrant: Purpose, minimization, authority, retention, privacy and resource costs, method, uncertainty, and stop condition.

type_registry.meaning: A bounded challenge, counterexample, or observation that defeats or narrows a model or proposal under its declared test.
type_registry.required_warrant: Target claim, admissible test, evidence, scope, consequence, visible uptake, and repair or retirement path.

feedback_contract.type_nonconversion_rule: Feedback types do not silently convert: recurrence is not learning, control sign is not moral valence, reward is not worth, monitoring is not affected-party voice, and a correction does not authorize action.

field_contracts.requirement: Name what is visible and what remains unobserved or protected.
Name the origin of the signal and its provenance limits.
Name the material, social, informational, or institutional carrier.
Name the measured or inferred variable without treating it as the whole referent.
State the modeled direction of influence and the convention used.
State observation, transport, decision, and effect delays or mark them unresolved.
State the observation and inference method with scope.
Retain measurement, model, causal, distributional, and horizon uncertainty.
Name exactly one or more typed targets from RECORD, BELIEF, LEARNER_STATE, MODEL, and PROPOSAL, subject to the feedback type's listed rule.
Name parties, access, challenge, visible uptake, dissent, and a no-adverse-inference path.
Name a condition that defeats the claimed signal, sign, path, or update.
Show a plausible causal path from an output-dependent intervention back to a future observed variable before using closed-loop.

typed_update_rules.rule: May update an identified control model or candidate control proposal under the named causal return path; recording provenance is an evidence operation, not an additional semantic update target.
May enter only the declared learner-state update; recording provenance is separate, and reward never becomes purpose, value, permission, or rights evidence.
May update only the condition-specific behavioral evidence model after functional evidence; the candidate label alone updates nothing.

May correct attributable records, accountable beliefs, or proposals with visible uptake while dissent and protected opacity remain; incorporation into a model requires a separately typed proposal or correction.
May update a bounded observation record or model under purpose, minimization, privacy, resource, retention, and stop constraints.
May defeat or narrow the named target and require review, correction, or retirement; it creates no replacement truth or action authority.

affected_party_contract.statement: Affected-party feedback requires accessible participation and visible response; telemetry alone is not voice, consent, legitimacy, or uptake.

reflexivity_contract.required_response: Record the intervention, behavior change, privacy and resource costs, distribution shift, and whether the measurement remains valid; otherwise challenge or retire the indicator.

feedback_contract.closed_loop_rule: Without a bounded causal return path the record may say observation, report, review, or proposed update, but not closed-loop feedback.
feedback_contract.non_promotion_rule: A typed feedback item may update only its listed RECORD, BELIEF, LEARNER_STATE, MODEL, or PROPOSAL target under its rule; it never creates purpose, authority, permission, consent, worth, being, Foundation text, publication, deployment, or action.

standard_isness_i6_mapping.atlas_registry_role: Six evidence-lane subtypes constrain provenance, warrant, and compatible update targets; they do not replace FREEDOM feedback, reward, reinforcement, or loop meanings.

target_mapping.non_equivalence: An allowed target does not establish that any update is warranted.
Belief revision remains attributable and evidence-bounded.
LEARNER_STATE names a declared learner update target, not a person, essence, or replacement definition of learner.
This atlas does not define a CONTEXT update target and does not infer that MODEL or RECORD is equivalent to it.
Proposal revision is inert until a separate current choice and authority admit an effect.
MODEL is an atlas evidence target and neither replaces omitted CONTEXT nor amends the source vocabulary.

standard_isness_i6_mapping.nonclaim: The mapping imports no authority, creates no second ontology, and does not claim exact target-vocabulary parity.

mathematical_core.constraint_set_rule: K is declared by a separately accountable normative and empirical process; no equation in this atlas supplies K, its legitimacy, or a right to enforce it.

models.expression: I_t=sigma(y_{0:t},u_{0:t-1}), x_{s+1}=F_s(x_s,u_s,w_s), y_{s+1}=h_{s+1}(x_{s+1})+nu_{s+1}, xi_s=(w_s,nu_{s+1}) in Xi_s for s>=t
models.model_scope: Post-observation discrete-time controlled dynamics: I_t includes observations through y_t and controls through u_{t-1}; B(I_t) contains modeled x_t compatible with that realized history; u_t precedes future uncertainty xi_t and y_{t+1}.
assumptions: F_s and h_s are declared
I_t=sigma(y_{0:t},u_{0:t-1}) is post-observation
B(I_t) is the declared set of x_t compatible with I_t under the initial-state, process, and observation model
u_s is selected from I_s before future xi_s=(w_s,nu_{s+1}) is realized
state, control, process-disturbance, observation-noise, and observation spaces are typed
future process-disturbance and next-observation-noise limits are jointly retained in declared Xi_s
models.conclusion: The convention distinguishes compatible hidden state, post-observation information, present control, process disturbance, and next-observation noise without granting access to future xi_s.
limitations: It does not establish the true system, complete compatibility set, purpose, consent, rights, or K.

models.expression: Viab_H^rob(K)={I_0 | exists one policy pi with u_s=pi_s(I_s) before xi_s, for all x_0 in B(I_0), for all xi_{0:H-1} in Π_{s=0}^{H-1} Xi_s, for all s in {0,...,H}: x_s in K}
models.model_scope: Author-synthesized post-observation information-state extension of finite-horizon robust viability for declared compatible-state sets B(I_s), dynamics, filtration, time-indexed future pairs xi_s=(w_s,nu_{s+1}), nonanticipatory policy class, and constraint set K.
assumptions: H is a finite nonnegative integer
I_0 is post-observation and B(I_0) contains modeled x_0 compatible with the realized history
K and admissible policies are declared
one shared pi uses I_s and selects u_s before xi_s, and cannot depend on hidden state or future process disturbance or next-observation noise
future uncertainty quantification is universal over Π_{s=0}^{H-1} Xi_s with xi_s=(w_s,nu_{s+1})
models.conclusion: Membership means one post-observation-compatible nonanticipatory policy keeps every declared compatible modeled state in K against every declared future process-disturbance and next-observation-noise sequence for H steps.
limitations: Aubin anchors viability theory, but this exact partial-observation robust formulation is an author extension. It does not choose K, permit pointwise or clairvoyant policies, assume stationary uncertainty sets, prove real-world feasibility, establish goodness, or promise indefinite survival.
declared_inputs: time-indexed future uncertainty sets Xi_s for pairs (w_s,nu_{s+1})

models.expression: Key_H(I_t)={u_t in U(I_t) | exists one continuation pi_plus with u_s=pi_s(I_s) before xi_s for s>t, for all x_t in B(I_t), for all xi_{t:t+H-1} in Π_{s=t}^{t+H-1} Xi_s: for all s in {t,...,t+H}, x_s in K}, H>=1
models.model_scope: Author-synthesized present action set after observing I_t, using one shared observation-compatible continuation for every x_t compatible with that realized history and every future pair xi_s=(w_s,nu_{s+1}).
assumptions: H is an integer with H>=1
I_t is post-observation and B(I_t) contains modeled x_t compatible with that realized history
u_t is measurable with respect to I_t and is selected before xi_t
U(I_t), time-indexed Xi_s, F_s, h_s, and K are declared over s=t,...,t+H-1
one shared continuation pi_plus uses later post-observation I_s before xi_s and cannot select different policies for observationally indistinguishable histories
models.conclusion: A key is a present post-observation-compatible modeled action for which one shared nonanticipatory continuation preserves modeled viability through t+H across compatible states and every declared future (w_s,nu_{s+1}) sequence.
limitations: Aubin anchors viability vocabulary; this exact information-compatible shared-continuation Key_H is an author extension. Pointwise successor membership with a different continuation per hidden state is insufficient. A key is not a cryptographic key, credential, capability, permission, consent, choice, execution, guarantee, or moral authorization.

models.expression: ReachAvoid_H^rob(K,T)={I_0 | exists one policy pi with u_s=pi_s(I_s) before xi_s, exists one stopping functional tau adapted to post-observation I_s, for all x_0 in B(I_0), for all xi_{0:H-1} in Π_{s=0}^{H-1} Xi_s: tau_pi(x_0,xi)<=H, (for all s<tau_pi(x_0,xi), x_s in K), and x_{tau_pi(x_0,xi)} in T}
models.model_scope: Author-synthesized finite-horizon robust post-observation information-state reach-avoid model with compatible states, safe set K, typed terminal or handoff set T, universal future pairs xi_s=(w_s,nu_{s+1}), one shared nonanticipatory policy, and one shared adapted bounded stopping functional.
assumptions: I_0 is post-observation and B(I_0) contains modeled x_0 compatible with the realized history
K and T are declared and distinct
one shared pi selects u_s from I_s before xi_s across compatible hidden states
one shared stopping functional is adapted to post-observation I_s and cannot inspect future observations, process disturbances, or next-observation noise
future uncertainty quantification is universal over Π_{s=0}^{H-1} Xi_s with xi_s=(w_s,nu_{s+1})
terminal obligations and residuals are separately declared
models.conclusion: One post-observation-compatible nonanticipatory policy and one shared adapted stopping functional keep every compatible modeled initial state and declared future (w_s,nu_{s+1}) path in K until the realized stopping outcome reaches T within H.
limitations: Aubin anchors viability vocabulary; this exact partial-observation robust adapted-stopping construction is an author extension. Swapping to forall-xi-exists-pi permits clairvoyant policies; allowing tau to inspect a full future trajectory is also clairvoyant; requiring one fixed deterministic realized stopping time before all xi is a different stronger claim. Reachability does not imply selection, execution, permission, terminal legitimacy, handoff acceptance, discharged obligations, or harmless ending.

models.expression: k(x) in argmin_{u in U(x)} ||u-u_dir(x)||^2 subject to L_f b(x)+L_g b(x)u >= -alpha(b(x)), for every x in D
models.model_scope: Continuous-time control-affine dynamics on a declared closed-loop domain D containing K={x | b(x)>=0}, with admissible control set U(x), differentiable barrier b, and a feedback selection k.
assumptions: the control-affine model is adequate on D
f and g are locally Lipschitz on D and b is continuously differentiable
alpha has the required extended class-K properties
for every relevant x in D, U(x) and the barrier inequality are jointly feasible
the optimizer or declared selection k(x) is a locally Lipschitz feedback satisfying k(x) in U(x) and the barrier inequality throughout D
closed-loop solutions under k exist on the declared interval and remain in D
the constraint is enforced continuously or a separately justified implementation preserves the cited conditions
models.conclusion: Under all assumptions, the closed-loop feedback k can render K forward invariant for solutions starting in K over the declared solution interval while remaining as close as the objective defines to the proposed local direction.
limitations: The theorem does not supply D, K, U(x), k, u_dir, global solution existence, goodness, purpose, authority, consent, or permission; domain-wide infeasibility, nonsmooth selection, implementation error, and model error remain possible.

models.model_scope: A declared representation map r:X->Z and one represented value r(x).
assumptions: r, X, and Z are declared
equality in Z is defined
models.conclusion: The fibre names states collapsed by the representation.
limitations: Shared representation does not imply identity, equal worth, interchangeability, or task-independent equivalence.

models.expression: q=g o r on declared domain D, with lineage X --r--> Z --g--> Q
models.model_scope: A declared task q, representation r, decoder g, domain D, and reference conditions.
assumptions: factorization is witnessed on D
task, domain, error notion, and horizon are fixed
lineage records preserved and lost distinctions
models.conclusion: The representation is sufficient for the named task on the named domain under the named criterion.
limitations: Task sufficiency does not imply exhaustive understanding, truth under shift, universal transfer, being, or authority.

representation_lineage.expression: referent state --representation--> public model --task projection--> bounded answer

dimensions.definition: Resource and throughput conditions for the referent and horizon.
limitations: No inventory or live flow is present.
dimensions.nonclaim: No physical theory establishes that a KINGDOM referent is living, good, or sustainable.

dimensions.definition: Compatibility with the full rights invariant for each affected party.
limitations: No affected-party evidence or authority is present.
dimensions.nonclaim: The dimension does not score a person or average away a breach.

dimensions.definition: Compatibility with declared ecological boundaries, externalities, and intergenerational duties.
limitations: No ecological assessment is performed.
dimensions.nonclaim: Assessment sources do not establish a local verdict or one universal value system.

dimensions.definition: Availability of materially distinct right-preserving next moves.
limitations: A modeled key-set is not a lived option set.
dimensions.nonclaim: Mathematical reachability does not establish permission, material access, or choice.

dimensions.definition: Source quality, uncertainty, remainder, dissent, and non-conversion discipline.
limitations: Structural design is not a live verdict.
dimensions.nonclaim: Reference closure or completeness of fields does not prove truth.

dimensions.definition: Capacity to challenge, record uptake, correct, appeal, and repair without erasing history.
limitations: No process has been exercised.
dimensions.nonclaim: A declared correction path does not establish accessibility or uptake.

dimensions.definition: Capacity to absorb disturbance while retaining a declared identity, function, or regime.
limitations: The retained regime may be undesirable.
dimensions.nonclaim: No KINGDOM referent is asserted to be an ecosystem, and resilience is not goodness.

dimensions.definition: Capacity of actors to influence resilience within the current configuration.
limitations: Agency and legitimacy are not inferred.
dimensions.nonclaim: Actor capacity in a source model does not establish consent, standing, or authority here.

dimensions.definition: Capacity to create a fundamentally new configuration when the current one is untenable.
limitations: Transformation can cause harms and needs separate legitimacy.
dimensions.nonclaim: Transformability does not establish that transformation is good, chosen, or authorized.

dimensions.definition: Readiness to transfer functions, knowledge, duties, and residuals without automatic authority transfer.
limitations: This is an atlas design dimension, not a source finding; no successor consent or capability is established.
dimensions.nonclaim: A handoff plan does not transfer legitimacy or establish successor acceptance.

dimensions.definition: Readiness to stop or retire without trapping participants, erasing history, or abandoning repair.
limitations: No retirement event is authorized.
dimensions.nonclaim: Readiness does not authorize retirement or imply non-being.

dimensions.definition: Material, social, ecological, epistemic, and repair burdens remaining after any terminal.
limitations: Unknown residuals remain open.
dimensions.nonclaim: A listed residual profile does not exhaust affected-party or ecological aftermath.

profile_model.comparison_rule: Only compare a dimension when referent, kind, boundary, definition, method, evidence, and horizon match; otherwise retain incomparability or NOT_EVALUATED.

temporal_capacities.definition: Continued occurrence or existence under a named observation and identity criterion.
temporal_capacities.nonclaim: Persistence neither settles identity nor warrants continuation.

temporal_capacities.definition: Bounded response or return behavior near a declared state or set under a named stability concept.
temporal_capacities.nonclaim: Stability is norm-neutral and can characterize a harmful equilibrium.

temporal_capacities.definition: Retention of a specified property across a declared uncertainty or perturbation set.
temporal_capacities.nonclaim: Robustness of one property does not establish overall viability or goodness.

temporal_capacities.definition: Capacity to absorb disturbance and reorganize while retaining specified identity, function, structure, or feedbacks.
temporal_capacities.nonclaim: No KINGDOM referent is asserted to be an ecosystem, and an undesirable regime can be resilient.

temporal_capacities.definition: Capacity of actors in a system to influence resilience within the existing configuration.
temporal_capacities.nonclaim: The term does not infer biological adaptivity, agency, standing, or authority for a KINGDOM referent.

temporal_capacities.definition: Capacity to create a fundamentally new system configuration when the present one becomes untenable.
temporal_capacities.nonclaim: Transformation is not automatically good, harmless, desired, or authorized.

temporal_capacities.definition: Renewal or restoration of named capacities, stocks, relations, or ecological processes under a boundary and baseline.
temporal_capacities.nonclaim: Regeneration requires a named baseline and does not imply full restoration or indefinite growth.

temporal_capacities.definition: A typed transfer of functions, records, duties, and residuals to a distinct successor without automatic legitimacy transfer.
temporal_capacities.nonclaim: This is an atlas design term without a direct source finding; succession does not establish same identity, successor consent, capacity, or authority.

temporal_capacities.definition: A deliberate kind-specific stopping or route-removal terminal that preserves required records, rights, repair, and residuals.
temporal_capacities.nonclaim: Retirement neither erases source nor implies failure, non-being, or person disposability.

rights_invariant.statement: The NORMATIVE_DESIGN rights floor recognized by this atlas, without importing authority, remains invariant under modeled state, reward, feedback, key-set, sustainability status, success, failure, continuation, transformation, or ending.

required_checks: separately typed and verified protective authority where applicable
minor_dependency_vulnerability_lane.rule: A child, dependent, vulnerable, future, or otherwise represented party may be unable to consent or participate; inability never becomes permission, defect, low value, or evidence of support, and a proxy or guardian never exhausts or converts that being's perspective or rights.

rights_invariant.ending_rule: A graceful ending preserves access, refusal, exit, records, outstanding duties, remedy routes, and residual burdens; it never treats persons as replaceable system parts.

protected_parties_and_dimensions: nonhuman beings where a legitimate framework applies
throughput_questions: What matter and energy enter, leave, accumulate, or become unavailable?
Which burdens are displaced across place, species, class, or generation?
Which renewal rates, depletion rates, thresholds, and irreversible losses are modeled?
Who can challenge the boundary, values, baselines, and distribution assumptions?
required_safeguards: no conversion of proxy account into the represented being's full perspective

process_and_becoming.statement: Process philosophy offers an attributed lens in which becoming, event, and relation may be ontologically basic; this atlas does not settle ontology.

aristotle_historical.statement: Metaphysics V is a historical source for multiple senses of being and for actuality/potentiality vocabulary; it is not a canonical classifier for this atlas.

autopoiesis.statement: Autopoiesis is retained in the original biological and theoretical domain of living-system organization; Di Paolo's analysis shows autopoiesis alone is insufficient for adaptivity.

dissipative_structures.statement: Dissipative-structure theory supports questions about far-from-equilibrium throughput, exchange, production, and maintenance only.

teleology.statement: Purposeful behavior, functional attribution, as-if goals, selection history, opt-in teleology, and moral orientation remain distinct; circular causality or negative feedback does not by itself establish telos.

counterexamples.title: Stable harmful equilibrium
counterexamples.construction: For x_dot=-(x-x_bad), every trajectory converges to x_bad, even when x_bad violates a separately declared rights or ecological invariant.

counterexamples.title: Destabilizing feedback
counterexamples.construction: For x_dot=-a x+b u and u=kx, x_dot=(bk-a)x; when bk>a the closed causal return path is destabilizing.
counterexamples.refutes: Feedback necessarily stabilizes, corrects, or improves.

counterexamples.title: Circular local direction without telos
counterexamples.construction: For x_dot_1=-x_2 and x_dot_2=x_1, d(x_1^2+x_2^2)/dt=0; trajectories have local direction and recurrence without a terminal attractor or declared purpose.
counterexamples.refutes: Direction, recurrence, or circulation implies telos.

counterexamples.title: Persistent hidden depletion
counterexamples.construction: Visible output can remain constant while a hidden stock follows r_{t+1}=r_t-c with c>0 until a delayed threshold failure.

counterexamples.title: Resilient undesirable regime
counterexamples.construction: A social-ecological regime may absorb disturbance and retain its structure while producing harms or blocking transformation.
counterexamples.refutes: Resilience implies desirability, justice, or goodness.

counterexamples.title: Autopoiesis without adaptivity
counterexamples.construction: Organizational self-production alone does not supply the regulation relative to viability conditions required by Di Paolo's account of adaptivity.
counterexamples.refutes: Autopoiesis implies adaptivity, agency, purpose, or moral standing.

counterexamples.title: Graceful ending passes
counterexamples.construction: A reach-avoid path remains inside declared K until a typed retirement or handoff terminal T, preserving rights and residual duties without preserving the current form.
counterexamples.refutes: Only continued operation can count as a viable or successful terminal.

counterexamples.title: Artifact sustainability does not imply practice sustainability
counterexamples.construction: Exact artifact bytes and provenance can remain retrievable while the associated practice is coercive, exhausted, inaccessible, or properly stopped.

concept_catalog.definition: A bounded expectation S(rho,Sigma) about one typed referent, declared invariant, boundaries, policies, disturbances, horizon, evidence, externalities, alternatives, and terminals.

Post-observation information states I_0 from which one shared policy selects u_s from I_s before future xi_s=(w_s,nu_{s+1}) and keeps every x_0 compatible with I_0 in K through a finite horizon against every xi path in Π_{s=0}^{H-1} Xi_s.

Present actions u_t selected from post-observation I_t for which one shared continuation preserves viability across every x_t compatible with I_t and every future pair xi_s=(w_s,nu_{s+1}) in Π_{s=t}^{t+H-1} Xi_s; never a cryptographic, credential, capability, or permission key.

Post-observation information states admitting one shared nonanticipatory policy and one shared stopping functional adapted to I_s that remain inside K until a typed terminal or handoff set T under every future xi_s=(w_s,nu_{s+1}) path in Π_{s=0}^{H-1} Xi_s.
A proposed local control direction filtered through declared barrier or constraint conditions.
A causal return path in which an output-dependent intervention changes a future observed variable, with sign, delay, method, uncertainty, and falsifier.
One explicitly typed use of IS rather than a scalar metaphysical or ontology classification.
A scope-bound representation that retains named remainder and task-relative limits.
The set of referent states collapsed to one represented value by a declared map.
Continued occurrence or existence under a named identity and observation criterion.
Bounded or returning behavior under one stated stability concept.
Retention of a specified property across a declared perturbation set.
Retention of specified identity, function, structure, or feedbacks through disturbance and reorganization.
Capacity of actors to influence resilience within the current configuration.
Capacity to create a fundamentally new configuration when the current one is untenable.
Renewal of named capacities, stocks, relations, or ecological processes under a boundary and baseline.
Typed transfer of functions, records, duties, and residuals to a distinct successor.
Kind-specific stopping that preserves rights, provenance, repair routes, and residual burdens without requiring current-form persistence.

edge_registry.support: The modeled Key_H set requires u_t selected from post-observation I_t before xi_t and one shared continuation across every compatible x_t and future xi_s=(w_s,nu_{s+1}) path in Π_{s=t}^{t+H-1} Xi_s.
A proposed direction is considered only inside the declared viable and barrier-compatible action set.
A retirement or handoff set can be modeled as a typed terminal rather than failure.
Bounded feedback may update the modeled estimate of the information-compatible Key_H viable-action set.
A non-singleton fibre is one exact witness of representational remainder.
Collapsed representation states cannot silently become identity-under-criterion claims.
Sustainable-under is a future bounded expectation about a named relation, not present existence.
Persistence can coexist with depletion, coercion, or rights breach.
A stable equilibrium may be harmful or outside declared K.
This atlas distinguishes robust property retention under a perturbation set from source-scoped ecological or social-ecological regime resilience.
Walker et al. distinguish adaptability as actor capacity to influence resilience.
Influencing an existing configuration differs from creating a new one.
An undesirable regime can be resilient.
This atlas proposes that a transformation may include a typed succession or handoff without identity or legitimacy transfer.
Creating a new configuration may require retiring parts of the current one while protecting persons and residual duties.
This atlas distinguishes endings that hand off functions from closure without successor.
Renewal of named stocks or capacities can support a bounded sustainability expectation.
A causal return path does not select or legitimate a direction.
A barrier-filtered proposal can preserve a declared constraint set under model assumptions.
Named remainder prevents a bounded expectation from masquerading as exhaustive certainty.
Retirement is one explicit terminal alongside continuation and transformation.
A relation that recognizes only current-form continuation can turn persistence into captivity.
This atlas requires a handoff alternative in relevant institutional, artifact, and lineage design questions.
Persists-under is an expectation indexed to an explicit continuity criterion.
Challenges and falsifiers may reveal that a model or proposal omitted relevant distinctions.
Route or practice persistence can end while source, history, persons, and duties remain.
A handoff set can be modeled, but acceptance and authority remain external.
Renewing stocks or capacities and retaining a regime through disturbance are distinct claims.

open_questions.question: Who has standing to declare or challenge K and each protected invariant for a particular referent?
open_questions.why_open: Mathematics does not supply legitimacy, and this atlas imports no authority.

open_questions.question: What accessible channels allow each affected party to challenge evidence and see uptake without forced disclosure?
open_questions.why_open: Access needs and protected opacity are situated.

open_questions.question: Which ecological thresholds, baselines, renewal rates, and irreversible losses belong inside a future evaluation?
open_questions.why_open: No site, ecosystem, inventory, or legitimate boundary-setting process is present.

open_questions.question: How should future generations and long-delay residuals be represented without impersonating their authority?
open_questions.why_open: Representation and legitimate standing remain unresolved.

open_questions.question: How may community-defined, sacred, and Indigenous values enter by invitation and governance rather than extraction or generic substitution?
open_questions.why_open: This atlas cannot speak for communities or collapse plural authorities.

open_questions.question: When does transformation expand right-preserving options, and when does it displace burdens or erase valued continuity?
What evidence and support make a specific ending safe, voluntary, repair-preserving, and non-abandoning?
open_questions.why_open: No live ending or affected-party evidence is assessed.

open_questions.question: When does a sustainability indicator alter behavior enough to invalidate its method or become a coercive target?
open_questions.why_open: Consequential use, gaming, and distribution shift are context-dependent.

open_questions.question: How should dependencies among artifact, practice, relation, institution, aspiration, effect, and lineage be represented without converting one status into another?
open_questions.why_open: Cross-referent causation needs evidence while cross-kind status implication remains prohibited.

open_questions.question: Which finite horizon is accountable to slow depletion, delayed harm, renewal cycles, and available correction?
open_questions.why_open: A horizon is a design and evidence choice, not a universal constant.

source_registry.title: A Survey of Viability Theory
source_registry.support: Viability theory, state and control constraints, viability kernels, and model-relative admissibility concepts.
source_registry.limit: The exact discrete-time robust partial-observation information-state kernel, shared-continuation Key_H, and adapted stopping-rule reach-avoid cards are author-synthesized extensions, not theorems attributed to Aubin; viability mathematics also does not choose K or establish legitimacy or real-world applicability.

source_registry.title: Control Barrier Functions: Theory and Applications
source_registry.support: Conditional control-barrier forward-invariance results and constraint-filtered control formulation.
source_registry.limit: Results depend on control-affine model, regularity, feasibility, and implementation assumptions; they do not supply normative constraints or establish this atlas's generic robustness-versus-resilience distinction.

source_registry.title: Resilience and Stability of Ecological Systems
source_registry.support: The distinction between ecological resilience and stability and the possibility of persistent regimes.
source_registry.limit: The ecological concepts do not by themselves establish justice, goodness, or sustainability for KINGDOM referents.

source_registry.title: Resilience, Adaptability and Transformability in Social-ecological Systems
source_registry.support: Source definitions separating resilience, adaptability, and transformability in social-ecological systems.
source_registry.limit: Cross-domain use requires an explicit bounded analogy and cannot rank persons or authorize transformation.

source_registry.title: Behavior, Purpose and Teleology
source_registry.support: Historical cybernetic distinctions among behavior, feedback, purpose, and teleology.
source_registry.limit: The 1943 framework is historical and does not settle contemporary philosophy, ethics, agency, authority, or a universal no-telos theorem; this atlas's feedback non-promotion firewall is NORMATIVE_DESIGN.

source_registry.title: Autopoiesis, Adaptivity, Teleology, Agency
source_registry.support: Argument that autopoiesis alone is insufficient for adaptivity and agency.
source_registry.limit: The source concerns biological and enactive theory and does not establish that KINGDOM is living or that people are components.

source_registry.title: Autopoiesis: The Organization of Living Systems, Its Characterization and a Model
source_registry.support: Original biological and formal characterization of autopoietic organization.
source_registry.limit: Autopoiesis is retained in its original biological/theoretical domain and supplies no KINGDOM-is-living inference.

source_registry.title: Time, Structure and Fluctuations
source_registry.support: Far-from-equilibrium dissipative structures and entropy-production/throughput questions.
source_registry.limit: The theory supports throughput questions only here, not life, telos, authority, goodness, or person-level inference.

source_registry.title: An Introduction to Cybernetics
source_registry.support: Regulation, feedback, variety, state, disturbance, and model-bound cybernetic analysis.
source_registry.limit: Cybernetic regulation does not establish purpose, legitimacy, moral value, or consent.

source_registry.title: Leverage Points: Places to Intervene in a System
source_registry.support: An evolving heuristic about system structure, information flows, rules, goals, and paradigms.
source_registry.limit: The ordering is a heuristic, not a theorem, universal ranking, authority to intervene, or source for this atlas's succession, sunset, handoff, or legitimacy designs.

source_registry.title: AR6 Synthesis Report: Climate Change 2023
source_registry.support: Authoritative synthesis of climate risks, adaptation limits, resilience, mitigation, equity, and long-term effects.
source_registry.limit: Global assessment findings require context-specific evidence and legitimate local decision processes.

source_registry.title: Methodological Assessment Report on the Diverse Values and Valuation of Nature
source_registry.support: Plural values of nature, valuation limits, and inclusion of diverse worldviews and knowledge systems.
source_registry.limit: Citing the assessment does not authorize this atlas to speak for Indigenous peoples, local communities, sacred relations, or nature.

source_registry.title: Metaphysics, Book V
source_registry.support: Historical multiple senses of being and actuality/potentiality vocabulary.
source_registry.limit: A historical translation is not a settled ontology, modern empirical result, or KINGDOM classifier.

source_registry.title: Process Philosophy
source_registry.support: Scholarly overview of process, becoming, event, and relation-centered philosophical traditions.
source_registry.limit: An overview maps positions; it does not establish process ontology as theorem or consensus.

source_registry.limit: The report supplies no scalar sustainability score, local verdict, or authority for this atlas.
